title: Leader, Systems Engineering
teaser: We are recruiting a Leader, Systems Engineering to drive technical excellence and architectural strategy for Cisco’s Solution Engineering team in the UAE. Lead a high-performing team, shape modern technology solutions, and engage with customers to deliver innovative solutions. Ideal for experienced technical leaders with strong people skills and expertise in AI, GenAI, and data centre solutions.
description:
Meet the Team
At Cisco, our Solution Engineering team plays a crucial role in driving technical excellence, innovation, and customer success. We are a group of passionate technology solution engineers who collaborate with customers, partners, and internal teams to design and deliver cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses. Our team thrives on solving complex challenges and enabling organizations to harness the full potential of modern SP technologies, AI, GenAI, SP mobility, cloud native, software, open source, cybersecurity and data center solutions.

Your Impact
As a Leader of Solution Engineering in the UAE for SP, you will be at the forefront of Cisco’s technology vision in the Middle East. This role requires a strong leader with exceptional people skills, a proven track record in technical leadership, and the ability to inspire and guide a high-performing team. You will be responsible for shaping the architectural strategy across modern technologies, ensuring Cisco’s solutions align with the evolving needs of businesses in the region.
 

Your key responsibilities will include:
Leading and mentoring a high-performing Solution Engineering team, fostering a culture of collaboration, growth, and technical excellence.
Defining and driving the architecture vision across AI, GenAI, software, SP mobility, data center solutions, and other modern technologies to support customers’ digital transformation.
Engaging with customers and partners to understand business challenges and develop innovative, scalable solutions leveraging Cisco’s portfolio.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and engineering, to align solutions with market needs and strategic goals.
Driving technical enablement and thought leadership within the Middle East region, positioning Cisco as the preferred technology partner.

Minimum Qualifications

B.Sc. in Engineering or a related technical field (Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent).

Proven leadership experience in a similar Solution Engineering or Technical Leadership role, with a track record of managing and developing high-performing teams.

Strong architectural vision and expertise in modern technologies, including AI, GenAI, mobility, software, and data center solutions.

Deep technical acumen with hands-on experience in designing and implementing enterprise-grade solutions.

Excellent people and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels.

Leadership and industry certifications.

Fluency in English and Arabic languages.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in the Telecom Middle East and Africa region, understanding its market dynamics and customer challenges.

Demonstrated leadership in building and leading collaborative, high-performing teams.

Strong public speaking and presentation skills, with the ability to engage audiences at industry events and executive briefings.

A passion for mentoring, coaching, and developing technical talent.

Knowledge of cloud computing, cybersecurity, networking, AI and automation in addition to core expertise areas.

Ability to drive innovation and thought leadership, positioning Cisco as a leader in next-generation solutions.

Fluency in French language.
 

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
